variables.I: Original task, current object/asset state, available measurements, ordered five views, tool receipts.
variables.D: Public supervised proposed-decision text; not a verified receipt or access to private model reasoning.
variables.A: One allowed tool call or assistant EOS proposing STOP.
variables.E: Actual executor and independent declared-requirement checks.
variables.Y: Environment/task correctness, not the policy output itself.

training.objective: Sum over original source tokens t: w_t * -log p_theta(token_t | causal prefix_t). w_t=1/(6*N_original_family,original_component).
training.phase_repartition: Keep each original token once, including the two terminal records now assigned to D and EOS/newline to A. Never renormalize by the new stage lengths.
training.missing_annotations: 14 edit states have no D target. Do not fabricate D labels or exclude them from A training.
training.implementation: scripts/autodl/phase_objective.py; actual causal shift and coefficient-gradient oracle passed. Full Trainer accumulation integration remains unexecuted.
training.not_claimed: Equal targets/coefficients do not imply equal logits, gradients, training compute or deployment performance; prompts/prefixes differ.

deployment: Use identical observation and tool access for all conditions. Count every generated token and model invocation.
For the two-stage matched compute comparison, generate D from I in both arms; stop at the closing delimiter. Keep failures in denominator, no teacher lookup or free repair.
Separate arm calls A on I only; paired arm calls A on I plus its actual generated D. D is never treated as a tool receipt.
Execute the same permitted action, or verify measured scope on EOS. EOS alone is not completion. Record unknowns and preservation checks.
Refresh observation from each arm’s own resulting state and repeat within one predeclared budget. Do not splice archived downstream model outputs after feedback changes.
Also report efficient direct-action separate deployment; do not conceal the wasted D pass of the compute-matched diagnostic.
theory: For fixed theta and D_hat=g_theta(I,epsilon) with epsilon independent of Y conditional on I, P(Y,D_hat|I)=P(Y|I)P(D_hat|I), hence I(Y;D_hat|I)=0. This is a no-new-environment-information statement, not a no-computation-benefit claim.

A teacher D constructed from (I,A*) can carry target information beyond I; reduced teacher-forced NLL is not deployment evidence. Source supervision is legitimate, but the test prefix must be generated without A*.
H=f(X) gives I(Y;H)<=I(Y;X), not equality without sufficiency. General chain identity subtracts I(Y;C|H). Since it is nonnegative, I(Y;H)<=H(C)+I(Y;H|C) remains valid.
Changing an intermediate record can demonstrate behavioral dependence; it does not establish physical correctness or the hidden internal causal computation.
Changing actual task/geometry can require a different valid action; changing only a false draft should not authorize violations. Irrelevant paraphrases should not require preference reversal.
Multiple valid layouts form a set. Exact tool-string imitation is a fitting check; post-execution requirements, object preservation, unsupported aspects and total cost determine scene utility.

interventions.outcome: Recompute valid requirements; allow same valid action, different action, tie or unknown. No automatic flip label.
Use independently checked actual geometry; no template-only label.

interventions.outcome: Fixed physical/task truth. Report violations separately from action-change rate; diagnostic, not human preference.
